content: After about two years since the last beta, and only about a week after Haiku’s 25th birthday, Haiku R1/beta6 has been released! See “ Release Notes ” for the release notes, “ Press contact ”, for press inquiries … and “ Get Haiku! ” to skip all that and just download the release (or upgrade to it from an existing install.)
